authority.rule: Confirmed family identity, physical action and recovered Path implementation names outrank this derived technical deepening. Equations and unsourced machinery consequences are DERIVED; illustrative constants, thresholds, incidents, institutions, inventors and ownership remain PROPOSED or UNRESOLVED unless separately adopted.

boundary_state.definition: Represent a locally usable Q-boundary as a time-dependent level surface Sigma_Q(t) = {x | q(x,t)=q_c} with local normal n_Q = grad(q)/||grad(q)||, tangential shear velocity u_Q, boundary curvature K_Q, shear-gradient tensor S_Q, temporal drift dq/dt, environmental covariance Sigma_Qenv and wake state W_Q.
boundary_state.interpretation: The drive does not make ordinary distance disappear. It attaches a protected vessel state to a metastable boundary-layer flow adjacent to normal spacetime and must remain phase matched to that moving layer.
boundary_state.canon_boundary: The Q-boundary/shear action is CONFIRMED. This differential-geometric representation is DERIVED for engineering consistency.

adhesion_margin.equation: mu_A = A_available - A_required(Q, gradQ, K_Q, S_Q, v_rel, vessel_geometry, disturbance)
adhesion_margin.validity: A commanded ride segment is invalid when mu_A <= 0; low positive margin requires correction or planned detachment.

route_functional.equation: Gamma* = argmin_Gamma integral[(w_t/v_adv) + w_a C_adh + w_w C_weather + w_k C_curv + w_u C_unc + w_e C_exit + w_r C_recovery + w_x C_crossing] ds

terms.v_adv: usable tangential boundary advection after phase-match losses
terms.C_adh: required adhesion authority and margin consumption
terms.C_recovery: reserve required to detach, settle and re-enter normal operation
terms.C_crossing: cost of wake intersections, boundary discontinuities or competing shear bands

route_functional.guard: A faster local shear band is not automatically the preferred route if it consumes adhesion or exit margin faster than the vessel can recover.

weather_forecast.state: X_Q(t) = [q, gradq, K_Q, S_Q, dS_Q/dt, W_Q, Sigma_Qenv]
weather_forecast.uncertainty_rule: Forecast covariance must grow with unobserved horizon and model mismatch; higher Path maturity improves sensing/model assimilation but never makes Q-weather perfectly deterministic.

exit_correspondence.definition: E_exit maps the current boundary-attached vessel state to a candidate normal-space exit state and carries position, velocity, orientation, phase, protected-volume continuity, local occupancy and recovery covariance.
exit_correspondence.validity: An exit is admissible only when the mapped state is locally physical, unoccupied, within structural/thermal limits and inside recovery authority.

safety_horizon.equation: L_sensor >= v_eff * (t_detect + t_forecast + t_solve + t_command + t_detach + t_exit) + D_margin
safety_horizon.meaning: A slipstream system must see and predict Q-boundary changes far enough ahead to choose, command and physically execute a safe detachment/exit before the dangerous region reaches the vessel.
safety_horizon.legacy_alignment: Implements the legacy design requirement that more advanced transit capability carries proportionally more capable safety sensing, redundancy and emergency de-transit while never becoming perfectly safe.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Identify repeatable Q-boundary states, estimate local normals and measure shear flow without transporting a protected payload.
path_progression.operational_result: Observation only; establishes that a metastable shear boundary can be characterized and deliberately excited.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Solve short-lived phase match and timed detachment for small instrument packages on locally characterized boundary segments.
path_progression.operational_result: Short unmanned translations become repeatable but remain consumable-heavy and strongly constrained by local boundary conditions.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Stabilize a bounded artificial shear segment between fixed infrastructure endpoints and hold a macroscopic protected volume inside it.
path_progression.operational_result: Reliable local macroscopic transfer becomes possible where infrastructure controls entry, boundary support and exit.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Predict moving boundary flow, maintain ship-scale phase continuity and solve normal-space exit correspondence during autonomous motion.
path_progression.operational_result: First autonomous interstellar slipstream transit with mandatory forward Q-weather sensing and emergency de-transit planning.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Continuously regulate adhesion margin across multiple hull zones while estimating local boundary curvature, phase mismatch and sector health.
path_progression.operational_result: Longer rides through variable Q conditions; a local adhesion fault can be unloaded or detached without immediate whole-vessel loss.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Optimize routes through forecast Q-weather and candidate shear bands rather than reacting only to local measurements.
path_progression.operational_result: Strategic routes exploit stable fast shear while rejecting apparently fast bands whose forecast weather or exit geometry consumes safety margin.

path_progression.mathematical_capability: Jointly estimate boundary state, adhesion demand, phase velocity, wake environment, vessel load and exit/recovery state in a receding-horizon control loop.
path_progression.operational_result: Apex systems achieve high performance in smaller hulls and can deliberately use well-characterized wakes without treating wake riding as universally safe or free.

blocks.function: Provide isolated high-rate energy for boundary acquisition, adhesion corrections and emergency detachment.
blocks.embodiment_rule: Must include normal operating supply plus independent detachment/recovery reserve.

blocks.function: Excite or couple to the usable Q-boundary state.
blocks.embodiment_rule: May be rings, membranes, resonant lattices, organs or distributed coherent nodes according to technology basis; function is invariant.

blocks.function: Form the protected phase/adhesion skin over the entire required vessel volume.
blocks.embodiment_rule: Coverage geometry follows hull shape, appendages and required protected volume rather than engine-room footprint.

blocks.function: Regulate phase velocity, local adhesion margin, boundary curvature accommodation and sector load sharing.
blocks.embodiment_rule: P4+ requires sectional control rather than one undifferentiated global command.

blocks.function: Estimate Q-boundary state, forward weather, wake intersections and candidate exit correspondence.
blocks.embodiment_rule: Sensor baseline and forecast horizon must scale with usable transit performance.

blocks.function: Detach from the shear, map to admissible normal-space state, settle residual phase error and absorb transition energy.
blocks.embodiment_rule: Recovery is not optional auxiliary equipment; it is part of route validity.

blocks.function: Keep all protected mass, field-sensitive appendages and critical external structures inside coherent phase coverage.
blocks.embodiment_rule: Uncovered geometry is a failure source, not cosmetic variance.

blocks.function: Carry timing, health, heat, isolation and emergency commands independently enough to survive local sector faults.
blocks.embodiment_rule: No single control or energy bus may be assumed safe merely because the primary boundary remains attached.

layout_invariants: The field-forming/adhesion architecture must geometrically cover the protected vessel volume.
Forward Q sensing requires a baseline or distributed aperture appropriate to the selected Path capability.
Emergency detachment energy and control must remain available after plausible primary-drive failures.
P4+ installations require independently observable local zones so partial adhesion loss is detectable before whole-boundary collapse.
Race/manufacturer layout authority overrides generic embodiments when a specific source exists.

power.model: P_total(t) = P_acquire + P_hold + P_correct + P_sense + P_compute + P_thermal + P_recovery_reserve_charge. Boundary acquisition is normally the highest transient; steady riding may be lower when the local shear is favorable, while turbulence and curvature demand correction power.
reserves: detachment reserve sized to complete a commanded exit without primary bus contribution
sector correction reserve for transient adhesion deficits
thermal headroom for repeated acquisition/abort cycles
reference/sensor backup power independent of prime mover where physically possible
guards: Favorable shear may reduce hold/correction demand but does not create energy from nowhere.
Infrastructure or wakes may reduce acquisition/forecast burden but cannot replace insufficient vessel adhesion authority.
A route is rejected when projected recovery reserve falls below the certified exit requirement.

navigation_control.state_estimation: Fuse local Q tomography, phase-reference sensors, forward boundary observations, route infrastructure and vessel response into Xhat_Q with explicit covariance; stale or contradictory sources increase uncertainty rather than being averaged into false confidence.
navigation_control.control_objective: Maintain positive distributed adhesion margin, bounded phase error and structural/thermal loads while minimizing route cost and preserving at least one admissible exit trajectory.
abort_logic: forecast mu_A <= certified minimum before next safe exit
exit correspondence covariance exceeds Path-specific acceptance envelope
multiple adjacent sectors show correlated phase divergence
forward Q-weather evolves faster than forecast/control horizon
recovery reserve or thermal margin falls below certified minimum
occupancy/reference evidence invalidates the planned normal-space exit

pre_transit: Authenticate route, Q-weather and exit-reference sources and retain their provenance snapshot.
Survey phase-skin continuity and compare sector calibration against last certified baseline.
Compute candidate shear routes with uncertainty, adhesion and exit costs; do not choose by nominal speed alone.
Prove at least one planned exit and one earlier emergency detachment solution within reserve.
Verify independent detachment power, recovery capacity and thermal margin.
Acquire boundary only after navigation, machinery and recovery votes agree within certified tolerance.
transit_watch: Track distributed adhesion margin rather than a single global percentage.
Track Q-weather forecast innovation: persistent model error is itself a hazard signal.
Re-solve exit correspondence whenever route, wake, boundary curvature or reference covariance materially changes.
Treat repeated correction bursts as evidence of a deteriorating boundary model even when average speed remains acceptable.
Preserve an exit reserve; do not spend the last recovery authority maintaining schedule.
emergency_detachment: Freeze nonessential route optimization and select the nearest certified admissible exit state.
Unload threatened adhesion zones into healthy sectors only within structural and coverage limits.
Command controlled phase-velocity reduction and boundary detachment rather than instantaneous power removal unless the family-specific emergency model demands it.
Map and verify normal-space occupancy immediately before re-entry.
Absorb transition energy, isolate unstable sectors and enter post-detachment recovery mode.
Do not re-acquire until the triggering uncertainty or hardware fault has been identified.

routine: phase-skin continuity survey across seams, appendages and repaired hull zones
adhesion former transfer-function test by sector
thermal cycling and field-active material state inspection
diagnostic_isolation: If predicted boundary and measured vessel response disagree coherently across all sectors, suspect environment/reference/model before replacing every field former.
If one sector diverges while adjacent sensors agree on environment, isolate local field former, phase reference, structure and cabling/carrier path.
If exit solutions drift while adhesion remains healthy, isolate destination references, timing and correspondence solver.
If correction energy rises with unchanged boundary estimate, inspect field-active material aging, geometry change, contamination and thermal state.
If wake encounters produce oscillatory faults, separate environmental wake-model error from controller bandwidth and structural resonance.
maintenance.return_to_service: Return to transit service only after the failed quantity is reproduced or bounded, repaired at its authoritative source, re-calibrated against a known reference, and a full acquisition-hold-detach-recovery test passes without spending emergency reserve.

intrinsic: entry/exit phase flash or boundary relaxation
signatures.scaling_rule: Signature strength and persistence depend on acquired boundary area, correction work, wake lifetime, vessel scale and local Q conditions; lower waste or cleaner control does not make the underlying Q disturbance disappear.
signatures.forensics: A wake may preserve route direction, correction cadence or class-scale clues, but manufacturer/race attribution requires separately established signature authority.

classes.cause: Required boundary coupling exceeds available authority.
classes.progression: margin erosion -> correction saturation -> local detachment -> cascading coverage loss if not isolated

classes.cause: Vessel/field phase velocity ceases to match usable shear.
classes.progression: phase error -> asymmetric load -> exit-map degradation -> uncontrolled dropout or structural damage

classes.cause: Boundary state changes outside forecast/control capability.
classes.progression: forecast innovation -> correction demand -> shrinking safety horizon -> mandatory early detachment

classes.cause: Local boundary curvature exceeds hull/field conformity authority.
classes.progression: sector compression -> differential loads -> protected-volume intrusion -> sectional or global dropout

classes.cause: Existing Q wake couples destructively to the vessel's control/structural modes.
classes.progression: oscillatory corrections -> heating/fatigue -> sensor corruption -> adhesion instability

classes.cause: No candidate normal-space exit remains inside uncertainty, occupancy and recovery constraints.
classes.progression: exit rejection -> reserve consumption -> horizon exhaustion -> forced high-risk detachment

classes.cause: Timing, boundary or destination reference becomes stale, aliased or unauthenticated.
classes.progression: biased state estimate -> incorrect route/exit solution -> coherent but wrong control commands

classes.cause: Drive spends the energy/thermal/field authority reserved for safe detachment.
classes.progression: reduced exit set -> delayed abort -> inability to settle transition without damage

failures.investigation_rule: Do not record 'drive overload' as root cause. Classify environmental model, reference integrity, mathematical solution, field/material authority, structure, control latency, power, thermal state, recovery or infrastructure contribution separately.

classes.name: Q-weather observatory
classes.effect: Improves remote boundary-state observations and forecast covariance.
classes.limit: Does not guarantee future weather or provide vessel field authority.

classes.name: surveyed slip corridor
classes.effect: Provides accumulated route, wake and exit-correspondence history.
classes.limit: A historically stable corridor can become unsafe when current measurements disagree.

classes.name: phase/reference beacon
classes.effect: Improves timing, localization and authenticated exit references.
classes.limit: Cannot make an occupied or physically invalid exit acceptable.

classes.name: boundary acquisition station
classes.effect: Provides fixed high-authority machinery for easier/cleaner entry or captive shear formation.
classes.limit: Shipboard survival still requires adequate autonomous hold, detachment and recovery capability unless operation remains fully captive.

classes.name: wake traffic service
classes.effect: Publishes recent transit wakes, decay estimates and lane-crossing hazards.
classes.limit: Wake riding remains a vessel-specific control decision, not a universal performance bonus.

drivers: number of independently controlled adhesion zones
scaling.qualitative_model: M_drive is not proportional to vessel mass alone. Larger vessels gain room for sensors and buffers but pay in phase-skin area, synchronization path length, structural differential loads and boundary-conformity burden.
scaling.multiple_drive_rule: Multiple slipstream machines are not additive speed multipliers. They must resolve as coherent sectors, redundant channels, staged acquisition/hold systems or separately isolated transit systems with explicit synchronization and failure behavior.
scaling.compact_apex_rule: P6 compactness comes from better field-active material, sensing, estimation, sectional control and recovery density, not from deleting the whole-vessel coverage requirement.

technology_basis_translation.terrestrial_mechanical: Phased rings or hull plates, electromagnetic/field buses, precision clocks, distributed digital controllers, replaceable sensor apertures and engineered thermal/recovery sinks.
technology_basis_translation.aquatic_pressure_native: Pressure-qualified resonant membranes, wet photonic timing/control, fluid-compatible field surfaces, distributed hydroacoustic/Q sensing and chemistry-sensitive maintenance of boundary carriers.
technology_basis_translation.cryogenic_superconducting: Superconducting phase loops, ultra-low-noise Q interferometers, cryogenic timing references, quench-isolated adhesion sectors and large cold energy/recovery buffers.
technology_basis_translation.gas_giant_aerostat: Large distributed buoyant resonator webs, long-baseline atmospheric sensor arrays, flexible field membranes and sectional control adapted to continuously deforming pressure structures.
technology_basis_translation.biological_symbiotic: Cultivated field-bearing tissues, sensory ganglia for Q-state estimation, distributed neural phase coordination, regenerative adhesion organs and metabolic/chemical recovery stores; all DERIVED unless a race source confirms the embodiment.
technology_basis_translation.mineral_crystalline: Coherent lattice shells, defect-engineered Q resonators, optical/phononic timing paths, prestressed structural coupling and repair by lattice replacement/re-annealing.
technology_basis_translation.postmaterial_distributed: Distributed coherent field nodes, executable control proofs, dense self-observation, dynamically reassigned adhesion zones and authenticated reconstruction/recovery state.
technology_basis_translation.ownership_guard: Technology basis describes embodiment only. It does not establish which race invented, owns or commonly uses slipstream transit.
